card.name: Scientific abstract structure points
card.fires_on: Structural points in research abstracts: the end of a section heading like Findings or Objective, an opening parenthesis after a term that precedes an abbreviation, and verbs like is after the study subject.

modes.label: Abstract section headings
modes.description: Ending of a heading word or its punctuation at the start of an abstract section.
modes.example: Methodology/Principal Find<<ings>> This school-based study investigated vitamin D

modes.label: Abbreviation parenthesis
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a full term, just before its abbreviation or a range.
modes.example: In vitro data suggest that vardenafil has the potential to inhibit P-glycoprotein<< (>>P-gp) at therapeutic doses.

modes.label: Subject then verb in aims
modes.description: The word is after the subject of a research aim or topic statement.
modes.example: Skip to Main Content The aim of this research<< is>> to develop a set of technologies and standards

card.plain: It marks small structural spots in a scientific abstract, such as section headings and the bracket before an abbreviation.
